Lead.title: Lead

dateCreated.description: Date and time the lead was created.

userId.description: Reference to User. (Relationship: User 1:N Lead). The user that created the lead.

admin.description: Grants the user administrative privileges across the application.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Authentication is handled by Firebase Auth; this collection stores additional user data. This collection utilizes path-based ownership.

definition.description: Stores leads associated with each user. Uses path-based ownership for access control. Only the user with the matching {userId} can access leads in this subcollection.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user who owns the lead.

params.name: leadId
params.description: The unique identifier for the lead.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to manage users and leads for the ChanceTEK platform. It emphasizes authorization independence and clear security rules.

The `/users/{userId}` collection stores user profiles.  The `/users/{userId}/leads/{leadId}` subcollection stores leads associated with each user. This structure leverages path-based ownership to simplify security rules and ensure that only the user who created a lead can access it.

**Authorization Independence:** The structure ensures authorization independence by using path-based ownership for leads. Access to leads is determined solely by the `userId` in the path and does not require retrieving data from parent documents. This allows for atomic operations (transactions/batches) without the risk of broken security rules due to hierarchical dependencies.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):** The structure enables secure `list` operations by segregating leads into user-owned subcollections (`/users/{userId}/leads/{leadId}`).  A user can only list leads within their own user document, making it easy to write security rules that prevent unauthorized access to other users' leads.
